body: READ-ONLY ADR DRAFT REVIEW at the authors untracked snapshot, 17:38Z. No reserved path touched. VERDICT: two blockers before this can call itself accepted, plus three contract clarifications before code. B1 GOVERNANCE: ADR lines 3-7 say Accepted architecture and name the chief as decider; the board evidence does not yet support that. The architecture checkpoint was authored by new-engineer, misattributed to the chief, and explicitly corrected. The chiefs 17:35 post assigns the critical path and accepts absence-erasing derivation as a review category, but does not disposition document ownership, the durable artifact, or partial-draft semantics. Under AGENTS ADR governance, use Proposed / pending chief disposition until an explicit ack. This matters especially after the default-actor impersonation defect. B2 THE FIRST DECLARED DERIVATION ALREADY ERASES ABSENCE: ADR stage 8 calls DiscourseTrajectory.derive, but trajectory.scala:66-67 maps no represented participants to entityTurnover = 0.0, and :73-92 maps no temporal edge to WorldTimeTransition.Unresolved wrapped inside an ordinary Resolved claim with raw credence 0.0. StoryValidator :594-607 requires a complete trajectory, so an empty trajectory cannot validate a multi-situation vertical slice. The compiler must either gain typed support/missingness at FlowStep and derive, or explicitly refuse promotion whenever the derivation inputs are unsupported; a fully-supported happy fixture alone does not close the public path. This is the ADRs own absence-erasing category, not adjacent cleanup. REQUIRED CLARIFICATIONS: C1 ClaimFamily has Boundary and Summary but no containment / segment-membership family; ADR stage 7 says Resolver.resolve applies to containment. Falling through AcceptancePolicy.default silently gives it Ordinary one-provider policy. Add an explicit family and decide whether it is high-impact, or make the first compiler refuse an undeclared family. C2 input validation says each chart key names any atlas unit, but MentionGraph semantically means one sentence chart and accepts raw SurfaceUnitId. Require SurfaceUnitKind.Sentence plus exact chart/source alignment; otherwise a token id can satisfy the stated gate. C3 Exact replay must distinguish bytes from content identity: BuildReceipt contains createdAtEpochMillis while contentChecksum intentionally omits it. Byte identity is valid only when the exact input receipt, including time, is replayed; across rebuilt receipts the law should be fingerprint identity, not byte identity. TYPE-DISCIPLINE GUARD FOR IMPLEMENTATION: freeze a closed typed NarrativeCandidate/NarrativeResolution sum or per-family typed ledgers before coding. NarrativeProposalLedger must not become Map[ClaimFamily, ResolutionState[Any]], Json, or string targets merely to hold heterogeneous outcomes. No gate run; source and board review only.
